يستهووا (form X)
# يَسْتَهْوُوا (yastahwū) /jas.tah.wuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْوَى (istahwā)
# يُسْتَهْوَوْا (yustahwaw) /jus.tah.waw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْوَى (istahwā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
